revision_notes: 2026-10-16: train-only audit revisions P1-P8 approved by Mahir before freeze; no validation data used. Draft, not frozen: decision tables, scorer and teammate review still pending.

2026-10-16: Renewal Term decision-table review, approved by Mahir: R1 retired RT-G4-01 'not to renew' (fired in 16 positive spans; ID not to be reused); R2-R5 added RT-G1-07..10 (renewed for, automatically extend, right to renew, additional one). Train-only evidence; see reports/keyword_baseline/decision_tables/renewal_term.md.

2026-10-16: Cap On Liability decision-table review, approved by Mahir: C1 retired the CL-G4 group (CL-G4-01..03; IDs not to be reused; 227 of 234 Uncapped chunks are also Cap chunks); C2-C4 added support groups CL-G7 (lost profits wording), CL-G8 (incidental/exemplary/whether in contract), CL-G9 (sole and exclusive remedy). Train-only evidence; see reports/keyword_baseline/decision_tables/cap_on_liability.md.

2026-10-16: Anti-Assignment decision-table review, approved by Mahir: A4 retired AA-G3-01 'transfer' (2,384 negative chunks; ID not to be reused); A1-A3 added AA-G7 (anchor: assign this agreement / assign its rights / assign any), AA-G8 (support: assignment), AA-G9 (support: may assign). AA-G4-01 verified on train and kept. Train-only evidence, sim F1 .635 -> .802; see reports/keyword_baseline/decision_tables/anti_assignment.md.

2026-10-16: Change Of Control decision-table review, approved by Mahir: CC1 retired CC-G1-02 'change in control' as anchor (ID not to be reused; precision .26) and added it as support CC-G4-01; CC2 added CC-G5 (support: may terminate / right to terminate / terminate this agreement / immediately terminate / automatically terminate); CC3 added CC-G6 (anchor: merger or consolidation / consolidation or merger); CC4 added CC-G7 (anchor: ownership change / change in the control; low support). No counters or vetoes. Train-only evidence, sim F1 .476 -> .559; see reports/keyword_baseline/decision_tables/change_of_control.md.

2026-10-16: Uncapped Liability decision-table review, approved by Mahir: U1 retired UL-G2-01 'unlimited liability' (only hits are 'unlimited liability company'; ID not to be reused); U2 added UL-G6 (consequential) and UL-G7 (except for/in/with/under); U3 added UL-G8, UL-G9, UL-G10 (named carve-outs); U4 retired UL-G3-01 'gross negligence' and UL-G3-02 'willful misconduct'; U5 retired anchor UL-G5-01 and added it as support UL-G11-01; U6 added UL-G2-03/04/05 anchors and retired UL-G3-04 'no limitation'. UL-G4-01 counter kept (0/36 chunks). Train-only evidence, sim F1 .315 -> .684; see reports/keyword_baseline/decision_tables/uncapped_liability.md.

2026-10-16: License Grant decision-table review, approved by Mahir: L1 added LG-G1-03 'grants' (anchor group); L2 retired counter group LG-G4 / LG-G4-01 'irrevocable' (135 TP vs 92 FP chunks; ID not to be reused); L3 added LG-G3-03 'nonexclusive' and LG-G3-04 'royalty free'; L4 added LG-G2-03 'license under'; L5 added support group LG-G5 (right to use, perpetual). No counters remain. Train-only evidence, sim F1 .717 -> .813; see reports/keyword_baseline/decision_tables/license_grant.md.

2026-10-16: Non-Transferable License decision-table review, approved by Mahir: N1 added NT-G1-04/05/06 (non-transferrable, not transferable, not be transferable); N2 added NT-G2-03/04 (non- assignable, nonassignable); N3 added anchor group NT-G5 (sublicense restriction). No retirements; NT-G4-01 kept (0 train occurrences). Train-only evidence, sim F1 .783 -> .817; see reports/keyword_baseline/decision_tables/non_transferable_license.md.

2026-10-16 Non-Compete decision table (approved K1-K6): retired counter NC-G4-01 'solicit' (precision .12, below base rate .032); added support groups NC-G6 (competitive with/to, competitive/competing product(s), competing business), NC-G7 (competitor(s)), NC-G8 (in competition, own/manage, named competitor(s); low support), NC-G9 (not market/promote/endorse), NC-G10 (any/a competitor). Train sim F1 .332 -> .497 (optimistic; thresholds chosen later on validation).

2026-10-16 Exclusivity decision table (approved X1-X4): retired anchor EX-G2-01 'exclusively' (precision .20), re-added as support EX-G4-01; added anchors EX-G1-03 'an exclusive', EX-G1-04 'exclusivity', EX-G1-05 'exclusively from'; added support EX-G5-01 'exclusive' with vetoes EX-V4..V6 (non-exclusive spellings). Kept EX-V1..V3 (removing them drops F1 .533 -> .506). Train sim F1 .306 -> .533 (optimistic; thresholds chosen later on validation).

2026-10-18 Expiration Date decision table (approved D1-D6): retired counters ED-G4-01 'automatically renew' (precision .89) and ED-G5-01 'effective as of'; retired anchors ED-G1-01 'term of this agreement' (-> support ED-G6-01), ED-G2-02 'expiration date' and ED-G2-03 'termination date' (-> support ED-G10); added anchor groups ED-G7 (commencement) and ED-G8 (early-termination qualifier) and support group ED-G9 (continuation). Train sim F1 .326 -> .719 (applied rules; the table's .727 also demoted ED-G1-02/03) (optimistic; thresholds chosen later on validation).
